newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy sets Argentine expansion.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy sets Argentine expansion.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said Thursday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Kenting Holdings (Argentina) SA from Precision Drilling Corp ration for $10.1 million in cash.

In addition, Key said it agreed in principle to buy the 37 percent minority interest in Servicios WellTech SA that it does not currently own from Burgwardt y Cia SA (27 percent) and Bunkersud SA (10 percent) for about $3.4 million.
With the Kenting acquisition, the company will have 22 well service and drilling rigs and about 350 employees in Argentina, generating annual revenues in excess of $30 million.
"In addition, we believe we can achieve significant consolidation savings in combining Servicios and Kenting."
Key also said it has closed the acquisition of Well-Co Oil Service Inc for about $21.6 million consisting of $17.5 million in cash and 240,000 common shares.
